==Original Dream Journal Entry That Inspired The Episode==
I had a dream within the dream of a broadcast from a villain who is causing people to uncontrollably laugh. I have a false awakening and hear that Ashley is missing. I go search for Ashley.

I end up at a warehouse. Outside the warehouse is an open grassy field. There I encounter the Laugher.

He wears metal red armor and fires bolts of green energy. His laughter power doesn't work on me, because I already knew about it. I am able to get in close for a brawl, but I quickly wake up.
